2317-3899-6763-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

2645-3430-4348-6256.description:

Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2390-6191-6824.description:

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.

When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

792-2511-2738-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5256-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5256-7316.description:

When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-2511-4068-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-2511-4068-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

4017-4050-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.

Repeat.

2421-2510-4050-6711.manaNeeded: {R}{R} if Sabin is in your graveyard or {2}{R} plus commander tax if applicable otherwise
2421-2510-4050-6711.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional card in hand.
2421-2510-4050-6711.description:
If Sabin is in your graveyard, cast it for its blitz cost by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card. Otherwise, cast Sabin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sabin and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Choose not to return Sabin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sabin dies, if it was cast using its blitz ability, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4740-4877-6613.description:

813-2072-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Scrollshift.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

914-2239-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2239-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Ardent Elementalist.
When Dockside Extortionist and Ardent Elementalist enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-2239-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

3518-5445-5660.notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
3518-5445-5660.description:

Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1819-4797-5510-5512.notablePrerequisites:
You have a number of copies of Relentless Rats in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
1819-4797-5510-5512.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Relentless Rats from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Relentless Rats in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Relentless Rats as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Cryptkeeper by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Tormod's Cryptkeeper dies, Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Tormod's Cryptkeeper ability, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

1283-2273-2440.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Slivers on the battlefield.
1283-2273-2440.description:
Activate Sliver Overlord's first ability by paying {3}, searching your library for the lowest mana value Sliver creature card in your library and putting it into your hand.
Cast the Sliver by paying its mana cost.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Sliver on the battlefield.
Repeat until you have no Slivers left in your library.
1283-2273-2440.notes: The amount of mana required to execute this combo fluctuates depending on the lowest mana value of Slivers in your library, as well as how many Slivers are on the battlefield as you execute the combo.
